title: Module status
description: A claim that a module was, or was not, collecting during a stated window. Which module is in the envelope; this describes the window. Not diagnostics: for a study whose model infers exposure from an absence of contacts, knowing when a device was actually observing is the difference between 'this participant met nobody' and 'we were not listening'. A period with no status observation covering it is uncovered, and must be treated as unobserved rather than as quiet.

state.description: `sensing` is the only state that asserts observation. The others record why there was none, which analysis needs even where a model treats them identically. There is deliberately no value for 'the app was killed' -- that produces no observation at all, which is the point.

window_start.description: Start of the period this claim covers. Consecutive windows from one device abut, so a gap between them is a real gap in observation rather than a reporting artefact.

window_end.description: End of the period. Equal to the envelope's `observed_at`, repeated here so a coverage claim can be read without its envelope.

detail.description: Which permission, or which radio. Never participant data.
